why: INTAKE-3251: confirm the canvas-to-folio rule for this ark before handing the target to the SOLVE parent; no manifest folio labels exist (207 canvases, 0 labelled -- tools/gallica_folio.py reports all 'NP', the fr16092-shaped case CLAUDE.md warns about), so the rule was found by eye-checking ink foliation numbers against fetched canvases.
canvas_rule: canvas = folio_number + 1 for a recto shown as the RIGHT page of an opening; the LEFT page of the same canvas is the previous leaf's verso (canvas X shows (X-2)v | (X-1)r). Confirmed at four points across the whole 207-canvas volume: canvas 12 = f.11r (this folder's own f.11 no.6, dated 14 Sept 1570 in the visible text -- matches Tomokiyo's date exactly), canvas 20 = f.19r, canvas 120 = f.119r (the birago-nevers-1571 excepted letter, ciphers/birago-nevers-1571's own cited image URL), canvas 190 = f.189r. Each recto's ink foliation number is doubled by an older, unrelated numbering visible faintly above/below it on some leaves (e.g. canvas 12 shows a larger '84' above the small '11') -- use the SMALL modern number, which is the one Tomokiyo's folio citations follow.
